description: SPLIT-SPECTRUM transposition: everything above frq_split moves by transpos1 semitones, everything below by transpos2 - independently, in place. Content-proven on a 220 Hz 10-harmonic tone with split 1000 / +12 / -12: partials below 1 kHz appear an octave DOWN (110/330 Hz series) while partials above 1 kHz appear an octave UP (2200, 2640 Hz) in one output. Mode 6 is the general form and subsumes the siblings (1-3 are hardwired octave versions, 4/5 single-direction: one transpos above or below the split); transpos values are signed, so 6 with a zero on one side reproduces 4/5. All four parameters verified time-variable: transpos1 brk differs from both scalar endpoints; frq_split, transpos2 and depth brks each run (exit 0) and differ from the scalar render (banner: 'depth,frq_split,transpos1 & transpos2 can vary over time'). frq_split CDP-enforced 5-22050 ('Parameter[1] Value (30000.000000) out of range (5.000000 to 22050.000000)' verbatim, nyquist ceiling); depth 0-1 ('Parameter[3] ... out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'). RUNTIME LANDMINE: extreme shifts refuse at run time with 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: Shift above frq split is too great to work.' (+100 st probed) - content/parameter-dependent, not a fixed range. Duration static (2.0230 in place); deterministic.
musical_use: Surgical register splitting - the spectrum becomes two independently transposable layers. Classic moves: keep the body and shift only the brilliance (split ~2-4 kHz, transpos2 0, transpos1 +7/+12) for artificial brightness or 'exciter' shimmer that stays harmonic with the source; drop the low register an octave under an untouched top for instant weight; or send the halves in OPPOSITE directions (the verified +12/-12 probe) to tear a sound into two registers - with a time-varying frq_split the tear point itself sweeps through the spectrum, a gorgeous slow-reveal gesture. depth is the dry/wet of the transposition effect (0 = untouched, 1 = full; ramp it to morph INTO the split). Unlike transposef there is no formant preservation - each band's content moves bodily, so expect re-voicing within each register; that hard-edged quality is the point of this tool. For whole-spectrum work use repitch transpose/transposef; for chordal stacking the pitch chord/chordf routes are broken on this build (copies at -28 dB, see findings).

frq_split.description: Frequency dividing the two transposition regions. CDP-enforced 5-22050 ('Parameter[1] Value (30000.000000) out of range (5.000000 to 22050.000000)' verbatim; ceiling = nyquist, input-dependent). Time-variable (brk run differs from the scalar render; banner-confirmed) - a sweeping split is the signature gesture. Required.

transpos1.description: Transposition (semitones, signed) applied ABOVE frq_split; 0 = leave the top untouched. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (2->12 ramp differs from both scalar endpoints, verified). No fixed CDP range - extreme values refuse at runtime ('Shift above frq split is too great to work.' at +100 on the probe); stay within +/-24 for musical results. Required.

transpos2.description: Transposition (semitones, signed) applied BELOW frq_split; 0 = leave the bottom untouched. Time-variable (brk run differs from the scalar render). Same runtime-refusal caveat as transpos1. Required.

depth.description: Transposition effect depth on the source, 0 (no effect) to 1 (full effect), CDP-enforced ('Parameter[3] Value (2.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)' verbatim). Verified live (-d0.5 differs from the default render) and time-variable (brk differs from both). Omit for full effect; ramp 0->1 to morph into the split.

examples.description: Tear a sound into two registers moving apart.
examples.expected_use: Above 1 kHz up an octave, below 1 kHz down an octave (content-verified octave pairs at 110/330 and 2200/2640 Hz from a 220 Hz source).

examples.description: Sweeping split point under a fixed opposite-motion pair.
examples.expected_use: The boundary between the raised top and lowered bottom climbs through the spectrum across the file.

known_issues: RUNTIME REFUSAL for extreme shifts: 'ERROR: Shift above frq split is too great to work.' (verbatim, +100 st probe) - a content/parameter interaction, not a pinned range; the curated bounds are advisory (musical_range +/-24).
No formant preservation - each register's content moves bodily (use repitch transposef for formant-held work).
Modes 1-3 are hardwired octave variants and 4/5 single-direction subsets (signed transpos verified accepted in mode 4); mode 6 with a 0 on one side covers them - all siblings execute()-reachable.
frq_split/transpos2/depth time-variability verified at the differs-from-scalar level (exit 0 + distinct render + banner confirmation); transpos1 at the full differs-from-both-endpoints level.
Duration static (2.0230 in place); deterministic (identical data chunks). Wav input auto-PVOCs through the engine; .ana mono by construction.
